main_line: 我只是试着把每一天，都过成自己精心选择的日子。
main_line_en: I just try to live every day as if I've deliberately chosen it as the day I wanted to live.

main_line: 整个神灯差事的一部分：惊天动地的宇宙神力！巴掌大的住的地方！
main_line_en: Phenomenal cosmic powers! Itty-bitty living space!

main_line: 我爱你。
main_line_en: Je vous aime. / I love you.
main_character: 娜塔莎·冯·布劳恩 / Natacha von Braun

main_line: 午后的诱惑最危险——理智还醒着，心却开始走神。
main_line_en: Afternoon temptation is the most dangerous — reason is still awake while the heart drifts.

main_line: 我想去加尔各答。
main_line_en: I want to go to Calcutta.

main_line: 语言是文明的基础，也是冲突中拔出的第一件武器。
main_line_en: Language is the foundation of civilization. It is the first weapon drawn in a conflict.
main_character: 路易斯·班克斯 / Louise Banks

main_line: 一个人生活，也不坏。
main_line_en: Living alone is not so bad.

main_line: 去哪儿都行。某个地方。随便哪儿。
main_line_en: Anywhere. Somewhere. Wherever.

main_line: 生活是个婊子，现在，我也是！
main_line_en: Life's a bitch, now so am I!
main_character: 塞琳娜·凯尔 / 猫女 Selina Kyle (Catwoman)

main_line: 如果你今晚做梦，请梦到我。
main_line_en: If you dream tonight, dream of me.

main_line: 一个人不能失去自己的尊严。
main_line_en: A man cannot lose his dignity.

main_line: 瓦坎达永存！
main_line_en: Wakanda forever!
main_character: 特查拉 / T'Challa（及瓦坎达众人）

main_line: 这是一个奇怪的世界。
main_line_en: It’s a strange world.

main_line: 看看我们。看看他们逼你交出了什么。
main_line_en: Look at us. Look at what they make you give.

main_line: 你好。我叫伊尼戈·蒙托亚。你杀了我父亲。准备受死吧。
main_line_en: Hello. My name is Inigo Montoya. You killed my father. Prepare to die.
main_character: 伊尼戈·蒙托亚 / Inigo Montoya

main_line: 在这曾被称为人性的野蛮屠场里，文明仍有微光。
main_line_en: There are still faint glimmers of civilization left in this barbaric slaughterhouse that was once known as humanity.

main_line: 你改动过去的一点点，就会改写整个未来。
main_line_en: Change one thing, change everything.

main_line: 赌场生意的首要规则，就是让他们继续玩，让他们不断回来。
main_line_en: In the casino business, the cardinal rule is to keep them playing and to keep them coming back.

main_line: 我很孤独。
main_line_en: I am lonely.

main_line: 过节团聚，是把旧账和新病放在同一张桌上。
main_line_en: A holiday reunion puts old scores and new illnesses on the same table.
main_character: 乌炤家族 / the Vuillard family

main_line: 我听不见，但我看得见。
main_line_en: I cannot hear, but I can see.

main_line: 请以你的名字呼唤我，我便以我的名字回应你。
main_line_en: Call me by your name and I'll call you by mine.

main_line: 原来你也在这里。
main_line_en: So you were here too.

main_line: 新鲜的，永远更好。
main_line_en: New is always better.

main_line: 世家的晚宴一开，堕落就会按席次入座。
main_line_en: Once the dynasty dinner begins, decadence takes its seat by rank.
main_character: 艾森贝克家族 / the Essenbeck family

main_line: 那一分钟，我记得非常清楚。
main_line_en: I remember that minute very clearly.

main_line: 大多数人宁愿被甜蜜的谎言说服，也不愿听刺耳的真话。
main_line_en: Most people would rather be persuaded by pleasant lies than by unpleasant facts.

main_line: 英雄可以是任何人。
main_line_en: A hero can be anyone.

main_line: 用红绳把彼此绑在一起。
main_line_en: Bind each other with a red cord.

main_line: 为什么你不停地画？因为太阳驱使着我。
main_line_en: Why do you paint without rest? Because the sun drives me.

main_line: 你要活，我陪你；你想死，也陪你。
main_line_en: If you want to live, I'll go with you; if you want to die, I'll go with you too.

main_line: 灵感不来的时候，整个生涯都像一场排练。
main_line_en: When inspiration will not come, a whole career feels like a rehearsal.

main_line: 我爱你三千遍。
main_line_en: I love you three thousand.

main_line: 换一张脸，不等于换得了一个人。
main_line_en: A new face does not give you a new person.

main_line: 我有话要说。
main_line_en: I have something to say.

main_line: 溃败的人在跑，跑的不是路，是故乡。
main_line_en: The defeated keep running — not along a road, but away from home.

main_line: 我撒谎——是为了能喘气。
main_line_en: I lie so I can breathe.

main_line: 熔炉的时刻到了：要么解放，要么灭亡。
main_line_en: The hour of the furnaces has come: liberation or death.

main_line: 废墟里长大的孩子，最先学会的不是哭，是怎样把罪过扛回家。
main_line_en: A child raised in ruins learns first not to cry, but how to carry guilt home.

main_line: 正当我以为已经脱身，他们又把我拉了回去。
main_line_en: Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back in.

main_line: 打记事起，我就一直想当个黑帮。
main_line_en: As far back as I can remember, I always wanted to be a gangster.

main_line: 佛肚空空，装的全是有钱人的秘密。
main_line_en: The Buddha's belly is hollow—stuffed with the secrets of the rich.

main_line: 要是你被困住了——每天都一模一样——而这件事永远不会有尽头呢？
main_line_en: What would you do if you were stuck in one place, and every day was exactly the same, and nothing that you did mattered?

main_line: 花，还是要画完。
main_line_en: Still — finish painting the flower.

main_line: 在南边，金钱可以买到夏天，买不到不被看穿。
main_line_en: Down south, money can buy a summer — not the right not to be seen through.
main_character: 艾伦／布伦达等 / Ellen / Brenda et al.

main_line: 活下去——像牲口一样活下去。
main_line_en: Live on—live on like beasts if you must.
main_character: 秦书田 / 胡玉音语境

main_line: 楼上楼下凿开一个洞，千禧年的雨就有了落点。
main_line_en: Cut a hole between floors, and the millennial rain finally has somewhere to land.
main_character: 上下楼邻居 / the upstairs/downstairs neighbors

main_line: 神看得见。
main_line_en: God sees.
main_character: 旁白/仪式语境 / Ritual voice

main_line: 这不是你的错。
main_line_en: It's not your fault.

main_line: 你到底是谁？
main_line_en: Who are you?

main_line: 等人人都成了超人……就谁也不是超人了。
main_line_en: And when everyone's super… no one will be.
main_character: 超能病／巴迪·派恩 / Syndrome (Buddy Pine)

main_line: 你以为你以为的，就是你以为的吗？
main_line_en: Are you sure that what you think you think is what you think?

main_line: 重复到极致的家务，会在某一秒忽然不再听话。
main_line_en: Housework repeated to its limit will, in one second, suddenly stop obeying.

main_line: 我们像两个陌生人。
main_line_en: We're like two strangers.

film_title_en: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
main_line: 我生下来就是为了活着啊！
main_line_en: I was born to live!

main_line: 有我在，别怕。
main_line_en: I'm here. Don't be afraid.

main_line: 真正无私的举动，总会点燃另一个。
main_line_en: A true selfless act always sparks another.

main_line: 不公开，不留记录，绝对保密。
main_line_en: Off the record, on the QT, and very hush-hush.

main_line: 皇上是世上最寂寞的孩子。
main_line_en: The Emperor is the loneliest boy on Earth.

main_line: 若要一切如故，就必须让一切改变。
main_line_en: If we want things to stay as they are, everything will have to change.

main_line: 你干吗把豆子都抖出来了？
main_line_en: Why'd ya spill yer beans?

film_title_en: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
main_line: 枪是唬人的，刀子才是专业的。
main_line_en: Guns for show, knives for a pro.

main_line: 就这样吧，现在。
main_line_en: For now.
main_character: 鲍勃 / Bob Harris（街边低语）

main_line: 还没呢！
main_line_en: Not yet!

main_line: 战争还没有结束。
main_line_en: The war is not over yet.
main_character: 玛丽娅·布劳恩 / Maria Braun

main_line: 你不是来做选择的——你已经选好了。你来，是为了理解自己为什么这样选。
main_line_en: You didn't come here to make the choice. You've already made it. You're here to understand why you made it.

main_line: 别再坚持了！没用的！再也没有什么可能了！
main_line_en: Don't keep insisting! It's useless! Nothing is possible anymore!

main_line: 一切尚未过去。
main_line_en: All is not yet past.

main_line: 到底谁才是怪物？
main_line_en: Who is the monster, really?

main_line: 一个世纪有两副面孔，像一对孪生的女儿。
main_line_en: A century has two faces — like a pair of twin daughters.

main_line: 这不会让我烦恼。
main_line_en: It don't worry me.

main_line: 妈妈说过，绝对不能跟任何人说我们的事。
main_line_en: Mom said we must never tell anyone about us.

main_line: 你有天赋，你有力量。而能力越大，责任越大。
main_line_en: You have a gift. You have power. And with great power, there must also come great responsibility.

main_line: 爸爸的花儿落了，我也不再是小孩子。
main_line_en: Father's flowers have fallen, and I am no longer a child.

main_line: 我相信上帝。
main_line_en: I believe in God.

main_line: 他们叫我纯洁，却不许我走进纯洁的门槛。
main_line_en: They name me pure — yet forbid me to cross the threshold of purity.

main_line: 公路尽头不是家，是一张还没说完的口信。
main_line_en: At the end of the highway is not home — it is a message still unfinished.

main_line: 谁才是真正的我？
main_line_en: Who is the real me?

main_line: 你听见的不是我的说话声，而是我的心声。
main_line_en: The voice you hear is not my speaking voice, but my mind’s voice.

main_line: 这既不是梦，也不是现实。
main_line_en: This is neither a dream nor reality.

main_line: 新桥上的烟火再亮，也照不进无家可归的夜晚。
main_line_en: Even the fireworks over Pont-Neuf cannot light a night with no home.
main_character: 阿莱克斯／米歇尔 / Alex / Michèle

main_line: 你看仔细了吗？
main_line_en: Are you watching closely?

main_line: 银幕里的人走出来以后，现实反而更像一场假戏。
main_line_en: Once the man on the screen steps out, reality feels more like a false play.
main_character: 塞西莉亚／汤姆 / Cecilia / Tom

main_line: 在这疯狂的世界里——只有疯子才能自由。
main_line_en: In a mad world, only the mad are sane.

main_line: 昨夜，我又梦见了曼德利。
main_line_en: Last night I dreamt I went to Manderley again.

main_line: 我现在是个人物了，哈利。大家都喜欢我。
main_line_en: I'm somebody now, Harry. Everybody likes me.
main_character: 萨拉·戈德法布 / Sara Goldfarb

main_line: 米兰的光再亮，也洗不掉南方带来的影子。
main_line_en: However bright Milan's lights, they cannot wash away the shadow brought from the South.

main_line: 你叫罗塞塔。我叫罗塞塔。你找到了工作。我找到了工作。你有正常的生活。我有正常的生活。
main_line_en: Your name is Rosetta. My name is Rosetta. You found a job. I found a job. You have a normal life. I have a normal life.

main_line: 沿着海湾跑，不是为了赢，是为了不被原油废景吞掉。
main_line_en: Running along the gulf is not to win — it is not to be swallowed by the oil-stained waste.

main_line: 刀可以放下，砧板前的人仍要立身。
main_line_en: You may lay down the sword — but at the cutting board, a person must still stand upright.

main_line: 听不见浪声，也能学会跟海相处。
main_line_en: Even without hearing the waves, you can still learn to live with the sea.

main_line: 在别人家里，爱也要先学会规矩。
main_line_en: In someone else’s house, even love must first learn the rules.

main_line: 保护别人，才能保护自己。
main_line_en: By protecting others, you save yourselves.

main_line: 你无法想象。
main_line_en: You cannot imagine it.

main_line: 哪种更糟：活成怪物，还是死成好人？
main_line_en: Which would be worse: to live as a monster, or to die as a good man?

main_line: 一切都是写好的。
main_line_en: It is written.

main_line: 你的火花，并不是你的人生目标。
main_line_en: Your spark isn't your purpose.

main_line: 我本不该回来，可我还是回来了。
main_line_en: I shouldn’t have come back, but I came back anyway.

main_line: 你可能会问自己：我是怎么来到这里的？
main_line_en: You may ask yourself, well, how did I get here?

main_line: 想拍苦难的人，有时最需要先学会让人笑。
main_line_en: Those who set out to film misery sometimes need first to learn how to make people laugh.

main_line: 杀了人，才能知道自己。
main_line_en: Only by killing do you know yourself.

main_line: 我等。等到可以回家的那一天。
main_line_en: I wait. Until the day I can go home.

main_line: 一个微笑，也许还有一滴眼泪。
main_line_en: A smile—and perhaps a tear.

main_line: 谁都不信谁——我们都累极了。
main_line_en: Nobody trusts anybody now, and we're all very tired.

main_line: 蜘蛛的巢穴很难逃脱。
main_line_en: The spider’s web is hard to escape.

main_line: 你跳，我也跳。
main_line_en: You jump, I jump.

main_line: 这个夏天，我想用另一个名字做自己。
main_line_en: This summer, I want to be myself under another name.
main_character: 洛尔／米卡埃尔 / Laure / Mickaël

main_line: 金刚跟我比都算不了什么！
main_line_en: King Kong ain't got shit on me!
main_character: 阿隆佐·哈里斯 / Alonzo Harris

main_line: 请不要为了我丢掉自己的奖金——可我还是想求你投我一票。
main_line_en: Please don't lose your bonus for me — and still, I ask you to vote for me.

main_line: 魔鬼拉取的最大骗局——就是让世界相信他并不存在。
main_line_en: The greatest trick the Devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist.

main_line: 两个生命共用一串音符时，谁先停下来，谁就成了回声。
main_line_en: When two lives share one melody, whoever stops first becomes the echo.
main_character: 韦罗妮卡／维罗妮卡 / Weronika / Véronique

main_line: 贪婪——找不到更好的词——是好的。
main_line_en: Greed, for lack of a better word, is good.

main_line: 你是太阳。太阳不动——是地球在转。
main_line_en: You are the sun. The sun doesn't move—this is what it does.

main_line: 现在我知道了天使不知道的事。
main_line_en: Now I know what no angel knows.

main_line: 我想有一间自己的店。
main_line_en: I want a place of my own.

main_line: 萧萧的命，是别人给的。
main_line_en: Xiaoxiao’s fate was handed to her by others.

main_line: 有人教你一条窄路，走出门才知道世界比路宽。
main_line_en: Someone teaches you a narrow path — only outdoors do you learn the world is wider.

main_line: 在动物城，任何人都可以成为想成为的人。
main_line_en: In Zootopia, anyone can be anything.
